concept.concept: Gothic farmhouse silhouette with roosters and pumpkins, text reads 'Raise Your Own Demons' in distressed blackletter
concept.audience: Homesteaders with dark humor, Halloween lovers, cottagecore-gothic crossover aged 20-40
concept.rationale: Intersection of homestead pride and Halloween humor is underexplored. October timing is ideal, the phrase is original and memorable, and the gothic-meets-rural aesthetic has growing social media traction.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "Raise Your Own Demons" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration, screen-print aesthetic. Centered composition: silhouette of a steep-roofed Gothic farmhouse with peaked gables and a tall chimney, framed by two aggressive roosters with exaggerated combs and tails on either side. Three carved jack-o'-lantern pumpkins arranged at the base, solid black shapes. All elements connected, bold simple shapes, clean sharp edges, high contrast. Limited palette: black, deep burnt orange, cream, charcoal gray. Solid color blocks only, no gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Plain solid cream background, generous margin, readable at 12x16 inches from across a room.
design.style: Distressed blackletter, bold weight, arched above the farmhouse silhouette, integrated into the composition

verdict.reason: The phrase 'Raise Your Own Demons' is a generic darkly humorous expression with no known trademark registration or association with a specific brand, celebrity, or IP holder. The gothic farmhouse aesthetic combined with roosters and pumpkins is a common folk-horror style with no distinctive protected elements. Distressed blackletter typography is a widely used generic style. No identifiable trademark, character, lyric, slogan, or celebrity reference is present. The design concept is original and low-risk for print-on-demand.

image_verdict.reason: The text 'RAISE YOUR OWN DEMONS' is correctly spelled and complete. The design features generic Halloween motifs (jack-o-lanterns, haunted house, roosters) with no IP concerns. Clean vector-style artwork suitable for garment printing.

listing.title: Raise Your Own Demons Shirt - Gothic Farmhouse Tee
listing.description: Wear your dark sense of humor with pride in this gothic farmhouse tee. A silhouetted farmhouse, roosters, and pumpkins create moody ambiance while 'Raise Your Own Demons' in distressed blackletter text celebrates agricultural mischief. Perfect for homesteaders with edge, Halloween devotees, and the cottagecore-gothic crowd who appreciate wit with their whimsy. Comfortable layering piece for autumn festivals, farm visits, or everyday wear that speaks your spooky-domestic truth.
